title: Watch Me Build an App With AI and Make a Sale in 85 Minutes
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

stated_problem.quote: So this is a pain because we're sending out PDFs.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Only Waivers: niche liability waiver link tool
idea.one_liner: Vibe-coded app where an organiser creates a waiver link (own PDF or generic) and parents tap to sign, for $13/year or $17 lifetime, launched to church youth leaders
idea.customer: church youth leaders and event organisers
idea.offer: shareable e-sign liability waiver links with stored signed copies

key_quotes.quote: There are waiver tools, liability waiver tools in DocYsine and e- signature tools, but they're all cumbersome and none of them are niched down enough for this use case.
Let people get all the way up to generating the link before they have to pay, but also don't hide the pricing page or anything.
In my experience, the best way to promote on Reddit is to just write a true factual story about what you've done and why you did it and not link to it.

claims.quote: It will use a Stripe API for payment and only costs $13 per year to use one plan, no free plan.

claims.claim: Early ad cost $137 per landing page view
claims.quote: I'm spending $137 per landing page view.

claims.claim: First paying customer within the session
claims.quote: I think this is a customer.
I've spent probably around 100 bucks in ads so far, including the time I spent offline six hours building this app to make $13.

acquisition_channels.details: Facebook/Meta ads set up via Claude MCP, ~$20/day, pixel on Stripe success page
story posts in Latter-day Saint subreddits and Facebook groups
links back to product in confirmation emails

ideas.delivery: Replit-built web app with Stripe and SendGrid
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR for children's/parents' data; DMCC Act subscription rules for auto-renewing plan

idea.name: Business plans sold alongside YouTube videos
idea.one_liner: Host sells business plans tied to his YouTube videos for $19 and $38

claims.quote: These 19 and $38. These are business plans that I sell for my YouTube videos.
